title: Pixel by pixel, this ship falls apart when you shoot it
author: wit1200
selftext:
Working on a space combat game. This is the destruction system I've been building - shoot the ship enough and pieces actually break off and drift away, piece by piece.  
Still early, just one ship right now, no sound yet… but this was the hardest part to get right, so wanted to share where it's at.

comments.author: Revolutionary_Heart6
comments.body: The ships are modular and customizable block by block? Or just static Sprites. This would be awesome if hit modules get damaged and disabled

replies.author: wit1200
replies.body: so there are layers to the ship, and one of the layers is the "Modules Layer" - thats where the player can place modules(Sprites) that he needs in an order that he wants. If a module is exposed by damaging the hull layer above and it gets hit, and it HP reach to 0 - it reacts(either blows up or affects the internal ship stats)
